operator_scope: offline only. No camera. The probe's ARM code executed under unicorn against out/MAIN_c0000000.bin with the codec stubbed in Python.
why: every previous test of PHASE=7 asserted on the SOURCE TEXT. That catches a deleted line; it does not catch code that assembles, reads plausibly and copies the wrong bytes to the wrong place. Copy-back writes into the camera's own frame buffer.
what_the_harness_does: maps the firmware image writable at 0xC0000000, so the probe restores its own hook word in place

maps the arena (0x45000000) and the writer's buffer (0x53B00000) TWICE each, at the handle and at handle+0x40000000, onto ONE host buffer via mem_map_ptr. Two separate regions would have let the copy appear to work while writing where nothing reads.
seeds what the host seeds: S_ALLOCATOR, S_HANDLE, the two proof magics, the three guard words the scratch phase leaves, and the 1 KiB IFD template plus its two table offsets
puts a REAL stock header at the buffer so the header copy and the template patch operate on genuine camera metadata
stubs F_INIT/F_ENC/F_SIZE/F_CLOCK and the original FUN_c069ac88, and RAISES on any other firmware address so an unmocked call fails loudly instead of running the image's code and returning garbage

two_defects_found_that_source_text_tests.cause: finish_source compares buffer[PIXEL_OFF] with its BEFORE value. Copy-back deliberately replaces 0x13400..0x13800 with the new IFD and tile tables, so the comparison always failed.
two_defects_found_that_source_text_tests.consequence_if_shipped: release would refuse to free a block that is fine, and the one phase where changing the source is the INTENT would carry a 'the source was damaged' error - masking a real one
two_defects_found_that_source_text_tests.fix: PHASE=7 records the AFTER values and skips the verdict, with the reasoning written next to it: the BEFORE values are taken before the encode and the encode finishes before the copy, so the ordering already guarantees the codec read an undamaged source. verify_compressed_dng on the card's file is the stronger replacement.

two_defects_found_that_source_text_tests.cause: `complete` overwrites S_STAGE with 8 on the way out, so stages 11 and 12 never reach the host
two_defects_found_that_source_text_tests.consequence_if_shipped: a test asserted stages that no reader would ever see
two_defects_found_that_source_text_tests.fix: S_FIT is the verdict and nothing else writes it; 11/12 are documented as progress markers that survive only a fault before `complete`

what_the_emulation_establishes.claim: a fitting frame is copied and ONLY seg[1] changes. The original routine is reached with seg[0] still pointing at the camera's buffer (0x53B00000), never at our arena, and with the compressed length.

the bytes that land in the buffer are a valid compressed CinemaDNG: verify_compressed_dng.check passes on them, including the length rule and the byte-for-byte survival of the original header from offset 8 to 78,848. This is the same checker that will be pointed at the card.
bytes past the copy are the original frame, byte for byte: the copy writes file_bytes, not the whole buffer
a frame that does not fit touches NOTHING. The buffer is byte-identical afterwards, seg[1] still holds the stock length, and the writer is given that stock length. Refusing is not an error.
the boundary is exactly the handed length: a file of precisely seg[1] bytes is accepted and one copy unit more is refused
no F_ALLOC, F_GET or F_FREE on either path; F_ENC and the original routine on both
the hook word self-restores and the stack returns to where it started
a wrong ordering kind is refused with ERR_KIND and the frame is untouched
the 'compress' kind still hands the writer OUR arena where copy-back leaves the camera's buffer in place - the distinction the whole design rests on

mutations_run.mutation: skip path publishes the new length anyway
copy through the CACHED alias instead of uncached
mutations_run.note: A GAP, and not a fixable one. Both aliases are mapped onto one host buffer, so the emulator cannot tell them apart - the aliasing is a hardware property. Pinned instead by test_copyback_uses_the_uncached_alias_on_both_sides in the source-text tests, which does fail on that mutation.
